Stage starts advance by t modulo week; split into gcd(t,week) cycles and slide an m-term circular sum, with full-cycle multiplicity when m exceeds cycle length. Use log1p/expm1 for numerical accuracy and handle p=1 and zero trials explicitly. No diagram or missing formula required.
